The inclusion gate · all four answers must be concrete
A plausible real-world object is not enough.
Which named gameplay system reads it?
What visible operational state can change?
What do employees do differently because it exists?
Why must that consequence be visible in the world?

entry and attendance become legible records without pretending to know
pathing, sightline, witness exposure, and camera
blocks movement and divides visible/observed space without becoming a wall
creates private paths and outdoor gathering edges while also hiding activity
